title: Trail warm-up, animal edition
storyboard: Film: naturalist leading 4 kids through each warm-up move at a Bengaluru trailhead, side angle, 2 takes
caption:
Our 1-minute warm-up before a trail.

The kingfisher move is borrowed from real life: common kingfishers hunt from perches anywhere from a few centimetres to a few metres above the water.
